method: Manual visual audit of four sampled frames at 0.3, 1.5, 2.9, 4.2 seconds from each actual five-second archived Pexels preview
scope: Visual-only provisional editorial triage; no audio, third-party rights or monetization clearance

rejections.review_notes: Both actual five-second preview windows show a small dog steadily chewing or pulling colorful fabric from a ball-like toy. No distinct unexpected reversal is apparent; the crowded prop makes the action harder to read on a phone. This does not justify replacing rank 5.

Actual preview shows a dog run toward and jump into a lake, with a splash near the end. The dog is very small in a wide landscape composition and the action has a predictable payoff, so this preview does not improve rank 2.
